capabilities: Push six screen types (daily tasks, due tasks, Dataview query, resurfaced note, writing stats, pinned note) to a TRMNL display
Send screen data as JSON to a TRMNL webhook automatically after edits and on a regular check
Support full-screen and mashup layouts on TRMNL OG and TRMNL X
Preview exactly what would be sent before pushing
Store webhook URLs in Obsidian's secret storage
extras: Rate-limited to 12 pushes per hour and 5 KB per push (30 and 10 KB with TRMNL+); on mobile, pushes happen only while Obsidian is open; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show vault data like today's tasks or writing streaks on an external e-ink display.

relations.evidence: Put your Obsidian vault on a TRMNL e-ink display.
